title: Where's Kinger?
blurb: Kinger is the chess-piece one: the longest-serving resident of The Amazing Digital Circus, thoroughly frayed by the experience, and extremely prone to wandering off. Asking where he has got to is a recurring situation rather than a one-off gag, so the fandom took the line up readily as shorthand for a friend who has gone quiet mid-session. Twelve seconds here, so there is room to trim to taste. Genuinely useful in a Discord call the second somebody's microphone goes silent for longer than is comfortable.
origin: A line about Kinger from The Amazing Digital Circus (Glitch Productions).
